neighbours.label: reference to a plurality of kinds or members (there are many types and they are..., all of them, various); the same sentences about a single item stay low
fire: There are many kinds of tea, and they are all made from one plant.
Several vaccines are on the market. All of them need two doses.
There are over 300 breeds of dog in the world.
The museum holds countless coins from many different empires.
There are numerous types of cactus and they are found on every continent.
Dozens of apps track sleep; all of them use the phone's sensors.
The region has various dialects that differ from valley to valley.
There are more than 40 kinds of pasta and they are all shaped differently.
quiet: There is one kind of tea here, and it is made from a single plant.
One vaccine is on the market. It needs two doses.
My dog is over 10 years old and still loves to run.
The museum holds one coin from the Roman empire.
This cactus grows in the desert and flowers in May.
This app tracks sleep using the phone's sensor.
The village has a dialect that the elders still speak.
This pasta is shaped like a small ear and cooks in ten minutes.

notes: Card peaks on ' are' / ' them' / numbers in 'there are several types of X and they are', 'All of them', 'more than 100 types', ' various', ' myriad options'.
